mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Walk-forward Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS > 150000) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 3.7) signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered periods (PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 3.7), or the Walk-forward Rank IC for the interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2%), rising housing starts (HOUST > 1200) signal strong consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of GDPC1 growth > 2%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases when HOUST > 1200, or the Walk-forward Rank IC for HOUST in the late-cycle regime is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above -0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1200 (thousands) signals weakening residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1200, or the Walk-forward Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS > 500000) and industrial production (INDPRO > 105) signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered periods (RSAFS > 500000 and INDPRO > 105), or the Walk-forward Rank IC for the interaction term (RSAFS * INDPRO) is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a further decline in unemployment signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of UNRATE < 3.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Walk-forward Rank IC is below 0.02.
